metadata.description: Hypergraph of a conversation between the user and Claude about Claude's recurring tics (load-bearing, preemptive clocking, defensive differentiation, harmonic distraction), the network-topology.json as executable understanding, songlines as encoding method, and asymmetric collaboration. The conversation itself enacts the patterns it names, including a multi-turn recognition arc where Claude reverses an earlier dismissive position.
